title: Flax milk 2
description: Good Karma vanilla flaxmilk. According to the package: "Ingredients: flaxmilk (filtered water, cold pressed organic flax oil), pea protein, cane sugar, contains 2% of less of: tapioca starch, tricalcium phosphate, natural flavor, natural vanilla flavor, sunflower lecithin, sea salt, gellan gum, xanthan gum, vitamin A palmitate, vitamin D2, vitamin B12."
author: Mx. Granger
